5084939.short: Adams (ankle) was designated to return from injured reserve by the Cardinals on Wednesday, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

5088571.name: Bryce Boettcher
5088571.short: Boettcher (groin) was a full participant at the Colts' practice Wednesday.

5092508.name: Colbie Young
5092508.short: Young went without a target while playing 19 of the Bengals' 74 snaps on offense in Sunday's 43-36 overtime win over the Titans.

5123663.name: Isaac TeSlaa
5123663.short: TeSlaa caught one of his two targets for 10 yards in the Lions' 20-17 win over the Packers on Sunday.

5150660.name: Anterio Thompson
5150660.short: Thompson posted on social media this week that he was diagnosed with a genetic mutation on his spinal cord in early May and indicated that he was told he will "never play football again," Josh Kendall of The Athletic reports.

5151083.name: Will Lee III
5151083.short: Lee (hamstring) is day to day but should have a chance to "test" his injury this week, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

5151317.name: Robert Henry Jr.
5151317.short: The Commanders claimed Henry off waivers from the Seahawks on Tuesday.

5155825.name: Carter Runyon
5155825.short: The Raiders activated Runyon (foot) from their injured reserve list Wednesday, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

5208518.name: Charlie Smyth
5208518.short: Coach Kellen Moore announced Wednesday that Smyth will be the Saints' kicker in Week 9, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.

5220680.name: Ted Hurst III
5220680.short: Hurst failed to catch his lone target in Sunday's 16-0 win over the Falcons.

8439.name: Aaron Rodgers
8439.short: Rodgers completed 13 of 25 passes for 172 yards with no touchdowns and one interception in the Steelers' 27-6 win over the Browns on Sunday.
